Which shortwave stations broadcast in Mandarin?

In the A-26 schedule, 56 stations broadcast in Mandarin. The most heavily scheduled include Sound of Hope, CNR1 Jammer/Firedrake, China Radio International, China National Radio 1.

What frequencies are used for shortwave broadcasts in Mandarin?

The most-used frequencies are 7310, 13730, 9730, 11600, 6280 kHz. Which one is best depends on the time of day, the season and your location.

How can I listen without a shortwave radio?

Use a free WebSDR or KiwiSDR receiver in your browser. Our Listen Online page links to receivers and explains how to tune. Schedules are in UTC, so convert to your local time first.
